criteria.requirement: Implement xlsxwriter.sheet_names.add_named_worksheet(workbook,desired). Sanitize Excel forbidden characters/control chars, trim whitespace and leading/trailing apostrophes, provide fallback Sheet, avoid reserved History and limit to 31 Unicode codepoints. Compare against actual workbook.worksheets names case-insensitively with casefold, allocate stable " (2)" suffixes while re-truncating base. Return the actual new worksheet and never rename/overwrite existing sheets. Handle long names, all-invalid names, repeated collisions and inputs differing only by case.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
